text: The UEBA system flagged CMP2946's week (2011-W08) due to evidence of atypical browsing behavior for a salesman in the Regional Sales team. Specifically, CMP2946 visited job-search sites 7 times this week, which is significantly above their usual range and also exceeds the typical range for peers in the same role. This suggests that CMP2946 may be browsing job-search sites more frequently than usual, which is unusual for someone in their role.
